decisions.reason: The mobile modular concept builds directly on the firm's existing processing know-how and shows positive early customer savings, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Slow-speed shredding is a core competence of the firm, and the dedicated website presence indicates continued learning and support.
As the flagship modular line with quantified savings and a reference customer, it strongly aligns with the firm's strategic direction and absorptive capacity.
The expanded slow-speed shredder line leverages accumulated shredding knowledge and complements the product portfolio, making it likely to be retained.
Although newer, the spiral shaft screens build on the firm's screening expertise and have dedicated product pages, indicating an intention to learn and improve them.
